title: The Signature Vision: Thermal Mass Cities
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Thermal Mass Cities.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Thermal Mass Cities becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

title: 2032 — First commercial city hulls plant sells mass walls power to the
definition: 2032 milestone on the Thermal Mass Cities roadmap.
description:
First commercial city hulls plant sells mass walls power to the grid under a 20-year climate tuning contract.

What must be true first: the mass walls results have to replicate outside the lab, city logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and phase-change materials operations need a year of continuous runtime. Signals to watch: peer-reviewed mass walls demonstrations, city logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting phase-change materials uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Thermal Mass Cities
definition: Estimates Thermal Mass Cities readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Thermal Mass Cities components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a city hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Thermal Mass Cities Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Thermal Mass Cities operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Thermal Mass Cities installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 99841 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where mass walls monitoring, city logistics redundancy, or phase-change materials maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Thermal Mass Cities Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Thermal Mass Cities: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Thermal Mass Cities — cities designed as giant thermal batteries.

Phase 1 — Prove (mass walls): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (city logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (phase-change materials): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (climate tuning): city hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and urban-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
